title: Add LibXml2 to the required library list
description:
Library is supported by all OS, and we effectivly already require the
library due to GLIB, libgcrypt, and GnuTLS also require LibXml2.

Ping #20508

notes.body: Both RHEL9 and Ubuntu 22.04 has 2.9.13 (vcpkg and MacOs runs 2.11.9)
I thought you usually advocated for keeping things buildable on RHEL8 for now?

I do :) I could set to 2.9.7 which is RHEL8 version. Gave RHEL9 version due to I have built newer GnuTLS with was also done with newer LibXml2. But yes, not everyone will run with GnuTLS so let's lower the version
